desc.en: Agentero placed second in the Boundless Application track of the 2026 World AI Open-Source Competition (GOAI).
desc.zh: Agentero 在 2026 世界人工智能开源大赛（GOAI）无界应用赛道获得亚军。

desc.en: In September 2026, Agentero placed second in the Boundless Application track of the 2026 World AI Open-Source Competition (GOAI).
desc.zh: 2026 年 9 月, Agentero 在 2026 世界人工智能开源大赛（GOAI）无界应用赛道获得亚军。

desc.en: On 19 September 2026, Urban Express reported on Agentero: a workbench built by three Zhejiang University doctoral students that keeps reading papers, taking notes, and asking AI in one place.
desc.zh: 2026 年 9 月 19 日，《都市快报》报道了 Agentero：三位浙江大学博士生做的工作台，把读论文、记笔记和问 AI 放在一处。

desc.en: Huawei Fan introduced Agentero at the Apsara Conference.
desc.zh: 樊铧伟在云栖大会上介绍 Agentero。

desc.en: InfoQ interviewed Huawei Fan, captain of the Agentero team. He is a doctoral student at the Zhejiang University College of Control Science and Engineering.
desc.zh: InfoQ 采访了 Agentero 团队队长樊铧伟。他是浙江大学控制科学与工程学院的博士生。

desc.en: Poco won bronze in Industry and Productivity at the national final of AI Hackathon Tour 2026.
desc.zh: Poco 在 AI Hackathon Tour 2026 高校联赛全国总决赛获得行业与生产力变革赛道的铜奖。

desc.en: On 18 January 2026, PhilFan won bronze at the Global Hackathon, Interaction Rebuilt: AI × Interaction.
desc.zh: 2026 年 1 月 18 日, PhilFan 在环球黑客松 交互重构｜AI × Interaction 获得铜奖。

desc.en: The team gave a talk in a lecture hall.
desc.zh: 团队在阶梯教室做了一场分享。

desc.en: The team gathered at Zijin Entrepreneurship Space, Zhejiang University.
desc.zh: 团队聚在浙江大学紫金创业元空间。

desc.en: Huawei Fan's campus charger lookup, ZJUCharger, received a software copyright on 5 February 2026.
desc.zh: 樊铧伟的校园充电桩查询助手 ZJUCharger 在 2026 年 2 月 5 日取得计算机软件著作权。
